title: Can not get sprite s to appear in the database or event

posts.author: Sir_Tiny_the_3rd_of_Italy
posts.body:
I'm fairly new to RPG Maker, and I've spent an hour watching every tutorial and reading every forum that seems even remotely close to my problem, but none of them are my problem.
I am trying to import my character sprites but they just won't appear. They are the correct aspect ratio (4 vertical and 3 horizontal -- specifically 1440 x 3840 px) and are a png. And I think I have the file named right. (Unless the issue is the file is a .PNG rather than a .png, but in that case I don't know what to do about that)
I have tried using the import button and just dropping them into the folder and still, they won't work. When They show up in the database but will not allow me to preview them like any of the other images or will it let me use it anywhere

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
Filenames are generally, and in this particular situation, case-sensitive.
I just tested to be sure: changing the extension of an image file from
.png
to
.PNG
caused it to vanish from my editor. Changing it back to
.png
made it reappear.
If the
.PNG
part isn't showing for you in Windows Explorer, try this:
https://www.howtogeek.com/205086/be...ns/#how-to-show-file-extensions-in-windows-11
Then just rename the file, like Turan said~
